scope: Independent bounded delegate evaluation with current workshop and matching CLI behavior references; no hardware

cases.prompt: Find the blue barrel, deliver it to Tag 0, smile and blink green.
cases.source:
behaviors.configure(move_mmps=150, turn_dps=45, contact_mmps=200, timeout_ms=30000)
behaviors.collect(BLUE_BARREL)
behaviors.deliver(BLUE_BARREL, TAG0)
robot.screen.show_emoji(Emoji.HAPPY, EmojiLook.LOOK_FORWARD)
for _ in range(3):
    robot.led.on(ALL_LEDS, GREEN)
    wait(150, MSEC)
    robot.led.off(ALL_LEDS)
    wait(150, MSEC)
print("Delivery reported; HAPPY requested; green blinking completed")
